Insurance Claims FAQ

Do you act as a public adjuster?

No. We provide construction estimates and complete approved repairs; coverage decisions and policy interpretation remain with the insurer and policyholder.

Can you work from an insurance estimate?

Yes. We can review the approved construction scope, inspect site conditions and discuss the repair plan with the property owner.
